title: Maturate
summary: MAT'URATE, verb transitive [Latin maturo, to hasten, from maturus, ripe.] To ripen; to hasten or promote suppuration. MAT'URATE, verb intransitive To become ripe; to suppurate, as a tumor, and form pu
